author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 산지 숲과 계곡, 낙엽활엽수림에 살며 전국에서 번식하는 흔치 않은 여름철새이다. 암수가 함께 지낼 때가 많고, 5~7월에 알 4개를 낳는다. 국내 전역에 살고 국외에서는 일본, 사할린, 중국에 분포한다.

points.en: dark brown upper mandible, flesh-pink lower mandible
wings with alternating white and black bands
black T-shaped band on the breast

young: 어른새와 거의 같아 구별하기 어렵다. 다만 아랫면에 노란 기가 더 돌고, 첫해 새는 윗면이 조금 더 갈색을 띤다.

art.subject: Forest Wagtail (Dendronanthus indicus), adult (sexes alike) in summer: crown, nape, back and rump plain olive-brown with a greenish tinge; a narrow whitish supercilium; wings blackish crossed by two broad yellowish-white wing bars, with pale edges to the tertials, giving a boldly banded look; underparts white with a black band across the upper breast joined by a short central black bar to a second, broken black band below it, forming a T-like pattern; tail olive-brown in the centre with white outer feathers; upper mandible dark brown, lower mandible flesh-pink; dark eye; pale brown legs.
art.pose: standing on the forest floor, side view
art.scene: Korean summer deciduous broadleaf forest in a mountain valley; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking on the forest floor: pale greenish-brown upperparts, blackish wings with two broad yellowish-white bars, white underparts, black breast band, dark upper and flesh-pink lower mandible, pale brown legs
adult, front view standing: white breast crossed by an upper black band joined by a central black bar to a lower broken band, forming a T-like pattern; narrow white supercilia
art.build: Slim wagtail, 16cm, a little longer than a sparrow but much slimmer, with a medium-long tail. Horizontal posture; walks on the shaded forest floor and also perches on branches. Bill thin, straight and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs medium length, pale brown. Unique habit: sways the tail and rear body from side to side, not up and down like other wagtails.
avoid: Do not paint grey or black-and-white upperparts like White Wagtail (Motacilla alba); the back is plain olive-brown.
Do not paint yellow underparts or a very long tail like Grey Wagtail (Motacilla cinerea).
Do not paint a single plain breast band; an upper band is linked to a broken lower band.
Do not show it pumping its tail up and down; it sways the tail sideways.
